hegemon_payoff_by_type.theta_0: (1/m)*sum_{i in W}{o_0*sum_{K subset W\{i}, |K|=q-1}e_{i,K} + (beta/m)*sum_{T subset W\{i}, |T|=q-2}p_{i,T}}, where for each i all e and p are nonnegative and the two displayed sums add to 1
hegemon_payoff_by_type.theta_1: (1/m)*sum_{i in W}{(1/m)*sum_{K subset W\{i}, |K|=q-1}e_{i,K} + (beta/m)*sum_{T subset W\{i}, |T|=q-2}p_{i,T}}, where o_1=1/m and for each i all e and p are nonnegative and the two displayed sums add to 1

outcome_distribution.pass_with_hegemon: (1/m)*sum_{i in W}sum_{T subset W\{i}, |T|=q-2}p_{i,T}, where for each i all e_{i,K} and p_{i,T} are nonnegative and sum_{K subset W\{i}, |K|=q-1}e_{i,K}+sum_{T subset W\{i}, |T|=q-2}p_{i,T}=1
outcome_distribution.pass_without_hegemon: (1/m)*sum_{i in W}sum_{K subset W\{i}, |K|=q-1}e_{i,K}, where for each i all e_{i,K} and p_{i,T} are nonnegative and sum_{K subset W\{i}, |K|=q-1}e_{i,K}+sum_{T subset W\{i}, |T|=q-2}p_{i,T}=1

equilibrium_records.payoff_date: R1 current units; frozen N1 continuation payoffs are multiplied by beta exactly once
